notes: Founder-led. Ishaan Patel (CEO, ex-devtools) is building an AI-first inbox summarizer + small support assistant. Very price-sensitive; mentions OpenAI pricing as baseline: "we're getting dinged on token cost for summary-heavy workflows". Wants a direct cost-per-1M-token comparison and rough examples for cost at 500k -> 5M tokens/mo. POC running on hosted API; used free credits, gave feedback: model quality OK vs GPT-4 for short summaries but wants latency guarantee for real-time UX (~200-400ms target for single-turn summaries). Key asks: simple predictable pricing (not opaque per-request), ability to set hard quotas, and clear guidance on throughput (burst to 30 rps). Does not need VPC/on-prem today. Interested in Optimize suggestions for batching caching to reduce token spend. Quote from call: "If Redwood can beat OpenAI on cost for summarization at scale and give me a clean migration path later, we can consolidate production here." AE recommended run small A/B vs OpenAI for quality/cost. Founder asked for trial extension and a one-pager comparing token math. Next: prepare comparator + sample cost table, confirm limits and rate plan, schedule 30m follow-up week of 2026-03-15. Quick PR FAQ live: /drive/paperkite/pricing-request-2026-02.pdf.
